actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.flowise_create_assistant.props.c: For OPENAI and AZURE: ID of the Flowise credential with the OpenAI API key. Leave empty for CUSTOM.
actions.flowise_create_assistant.props.d: Assistant settings as an object, e.g. `{"name":"Support bot","description":"...","model":"gpt-4o","instructions":"..."}`. `name` is required for CUSTOM.
actions.flowise_create_assistant.props.t: CUSTOM keeps the assistant in Flowise; OPENAI and AZURE also create it on OpenAI.
actions.flowise_create_attachments.descr: Uploads a file to a chat and returns its extracted content.
actions.flowise_create_attachments.props: Return the file content as base64 instead of extracted text.
ID of one chat session, returned as `chatId` by Make Prediction and List Chat Messages.
ID of the chatflow (agentflow or assistant flow). Use List Chatflows to find it.
actions.flowise_create_chatflow.props.fl: The flow graph as a JSON string, e.g. `{"nodes":[],"edges":[]}`. Copy it from Get Chatflow to clone a flow.
actions.flowise_create_chatflow.props.is: Whether the chatflow is publicly accessible without an API key.
actions.flowise_create_chatflow.props.ty: Kind of flow. Use CHATFLOW for a classic chatflow.
actions.flowise_create_feedback.descript: Leaves feedback on a chat message.
actions.flowise_create_feedback.props.ch: ID of one chat session, returned as `chatId` by Make Prediction and List Chat Messages.
ID of the chatflow (agentflow or assistant flow). Use List Chatflows to find it.
actions.flowise_create_feedback.props.me: ID of the bot message to rate: `chatMessageId` from Make Prediction or `id` from List Chat Messages.
actions.flowise_create_lead.description: Adds a lead to a chatflow.
actions.flowise_create_lead.props.chatId: Chat session the lead came from. Flowise generates one when empty.
actions.flowise_create_lead.props.chatfl: ID of the chatflow (agentflow or assistant flow). Use List Chatflows to find it.
actions.flowise_create_tool.description: Creates a custom tool that flows can call.
Background color of the tool card, e.g. `linear-gradient(rgb(0,0,0), rgb(0,0,0))` or `#4CAF50`.
actions.flowise_create_tool.props.descri: What the tool does and when the LLM should call it.
actions.flowise_create_tool.props.func.d: JavaScript the tool runs. Inputs are available as `$<property>`, e.g. `$city`. Must return a string.
actions.flowise_create_tool.props.name.d: Tool name the LLM sees, in snake_case, e.g. `get_weather`.
actions.flowise_create_tool.props.schema: JSON string array of input fields, e.g. `[{"id":0,"property":"city","type":"string","description":"City name","required":true}]`.
actions.flowise_create_variable.props.ty: Static stores the value; runtime reads the server environment variable. Defaults to static.
actions.flowise_create_variable.props.va: Value of the variable. Required for runtime variables too, where it is ignored.
actions.flowise_delete_assistant.props.a: ID of the assistant, from List Assistants.
actions.flowise_delete_assistant.props.i: For OPENAI and AZURE assistants: also delete the assistant on OpenAI.
actions.flowise_delete_chat_messages.des: Deletes the chat messages of a chatflow that match the filters.
actions.flowise_delete_chat_messages.pro: Only delete messages from this chat session.
INTERNAL = chats from the Flowise UI, EXTERNAL = chats through the API or embed.
ID of the chatflow (agentflow or assistant flow). Use List Chatflows to find it.
Only include records created on or before this date (ISO 8601).
Also delete the messages from the memory node of the flow.
Only delete messages with this memory session ID.
Only include records created on or after this date (ISO 8601).
actions.flowise_delete_chatflow.props.ch: ID of the chatflow (agentflow or assistant flow). Use List Chatflows to find it.
actions.flowise_delete_document_chunk.de: Permanently deletes one chunk from a document loader.
actions.flowise_delete_document_chunk.pr: ID of the chunk, from Get Document Chunks.
ID of a document loader inside the store, from the `loaders` array of Get Document Store.
ID of the document store. Use List Document Stores to find it.
actions.flowise_delete_document_loader.d: Permanently deletes a document loader and its chunks.
actions.flowise_delete_document_loader.p: ID of a document loader inside the store, from the `loaders` array of Get Document Store.
ID of the document store. Use List Document Stores to find it.
actions.flowise_delete_document_store.pr: ID of the document store. Use List Document Stores to find it.
actions.flowise_delete_tool.props.toolId: ID of the tool, from List Tools.
actions.flowise_delete_variable.props.va: ID of the variable, from List Variables.
actions.flowise_delete_vector_store_data: Deletes the data a document store upserted into its vector store.
ID of the document store. Use List Document Stores to find it.
actions.flowise_get_assistant.props.assi: ID of the assistant, from List Assistants.
actions.flowise_get_chatflow.props.chatf: ID of the chatflow (agentflow or assistant flow). Use List Chatflows to find it.
actions.flowise_get_document_chunks.desc: Gets one page of the chunks of a document loader.
actions.flowise_get_document_chunks.prop: ID of a document loader inside the store, from the `loaders` array of Get Document Store.
Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.
ID of the document store. Use List Document Stores to find it.
actions.flowise_get_document_store.descr: Gets one document store by ID.
actions.flowise_get_document_store.props: ID of the document store. Use List Document Stores to find it.
actions.flowise_get_tool.description: Gets one custom tool by ID.
actions.flowise_get_tool.props.toolId.de: ID of the tool, from List Tools.
actions.flowise_list_assistants.descript: Lists the assistants in the workspace.
actions.flowise_list_assistants.props.ty: Only list assistants of this type.
actions.flowise_list_chat_messages.descr: Lists the chat messages of a chatflow, with optional filters.
actions.flowise_list_chat_messages.props: Only messages from this chat session.
INTERNAL = chats from the Flowise UI, EXTERNAL = chats through the API or embed.
ID of the chatflow (agentflow or assistant flow). Use List Chatflows to find it.
Only include records created on or before this date (ISO 8601).
Only messages that received this feedback.
Sort by creation date. Defaults to ascending.
Only messages with this memory session ID.
Only include records created on or after this date (ISO 8601).
actions.flowise_list_chatflows.descripti: Lists every chatflow in the Flowise workspace.
actions.flowise_list_document_stores.des: Lists the document stores in the workspace.
actions.flowise_list_feedback.descriptio: Lists the chat message feedback of a chatflow.
actions.flowise_list_feedback.props.chat: Only feedback from this chat session.
ID of the chatflow (agentflow or assistant flow). Use List Chatflows to find it.
actions.flowise_list_feedback.props.endD: Only include records created on or before this date (ISO 8601).
actions.flowise_list_feedback.props.star: Only include records created on or after this date (ISO 8601).
actions.flowise_list_leads.description: Lists the leads captured by a chatflow.
actions.flowise_list_leads.props.chatflo: ID of the chatflow (agentflow or assistant flow). Use List Chatflows to find it.
actions.flowise_list_tools.description: Lists the custom tools in the workspace.
actions.flowise_list_variables.descripti: Lists the variables in the workspace.
actions.flowise_query_document_store.des: Runs a retrieval query against a document store.
actions.flowise_query_document_store.pro: ID of the document store. Use List Document Stores to find it.
actions.flowise_refresh_document_store.d: Re-processes and re-upserts every document in a document store.
actions.flowise_refresh_document_store.p: Optional array of per-loader configs to use instead of the saved ones, in the Upsert Document format.
ID of the document store. Use List Document Stores to find it.
actions.flowise_update_assistant.props.a: ID of the assistant, from List Assistants.
actions.flowise_update_assistant.props.c: For OPENAI and AZURE: ID of the Flowise credential with the OpenAI API key.
actions.flowise_update_assistant.props.d: Full assistant settings object; replaces the current one. Must include `name` for CUSTOM.
actions.flowise_update_chatflow.descript: Updates a chatflow. Only the fields you set are changed.
actions.flowise_update_chatflow.props.ch: ID of the chatflow (agentflow or assistant flow). Use List Chatflows to find it.
actions.flowise_update_chatflow.props.fl: New flow graph as a JSON string; replaces the whole graph.
actions.flowise_update_chatflow.props.is: Whether the chatflow is publicly accessible without an API key.
actions.flowise_update_document_chunk.de: Replaces the text and metadata of one chunk.
actions.flowise_update_document_chunk.pr: ID of the chunk, from Get Document Chunks.
ID of a document loader inside the store, from the `loaders` array of Get Document Store.
New metadata object of the chunk.
ID of the document store. Use List Document Stores to find it.
actions.flowise_update_document_store.de: Renames a document store or changes its description.
actions.flowise_update_document_store.pr: ID of the document store. Use List Document Stores to find it.
actions.flowise_update_feedback.descript: Changes the rating or comment of a feedback entry.
actions.flowise_update_feedback.props.fe: ID of the feedback entry, from List Feedback or Create Feedback.
actions.flowise_update_tool.description: Updates a custom tool. Only the fields you set are changed.
actions.flowise_update_tool.props.schema: New input schema as a JSON string array; replaces the current one.
actions.flowise_update_tool.props.toolId: ID of the tool, from List Tools.
actions.flowise_update_variable.descript: Updates a workspace variable. Only the fields you set are changed.
actions.flowise_update_variable.props.ty: Static stores the value; runtime reads the server environment variable.
actions.flowise_update_variable.props.va: ID of the variable, from List Variables.
actions.flowise_upsert_document.descript: Loads, splits and upserts a document into a document store.
actions.flowise_upsert_document.props.do: ID of an existing loader in the store to re-run. Leave empty to add a new loader from Loader.
actions.flowise_upsert_document.props.re: Record manager config. Needed for Delete Vector Store Data to remove these chunks later.
Replace the existing loader config and chunks instead of merging.
actions.flowise_upsert_document.props.st: ID of the document store. Use List Document Stores to find it.
